messages:
natalie: Heads-up: next Tuesday (2026-05-05 03:00 UTC) we'll migrate CI secret storage from GitHub repo secrets to our centralized Vault-backed provider. This affects GitHub Actions, Buildkite, and self-hosted agents that read repo-level secrets.

natalie: TL;DR: stop creating new repo secrets; migrate values into Vault paths like `secret/ci/<repo>` and update workflows to use `hashicorp/vault-action` or our token-exchange endpoint. Cutover window 03:00-03:30 UTC, expected disruption <10m.

omar: ack. What's the migration approach? automated or manual?

natalie: We'll run an automated export for approved repos (owners listed in PLAT-10111). For unapproved/archived repos we'll create tickets. Dry-run on staging at 01:00 UTC. Migration script: `scripts/vault/migrate-repo-secrets.sh --org redwood --dry-run`. It will redact values in audit logs.

kevin: Any changes required in workflows?

natalie: Yes: replace usages of `secrets.MY_SECRET` with the action that fetches from Vault and writes to env, or use our OIDC-backed short-lived tokens to fetch during the job. Example snippet posted in PLAT-10111.

security: Important: We will rotate any existing secret values as part of migration and issue new versioned keys in Vault. Update downstream integrations that reference static token values. We'll blacklist old repo secrets 24h after cutover.

vault-bot: Dry-run scheduled in staging 2026-05-05 01:00 UTC. Will post report of repos touched.

infra-oncall: Rollback: we keep a snapshot of exported secrets (encrypted) and can revert access controls for 30m. We'll only rollback if >5% of CI runs fail due to missing secrets.

kevin: How do I find repo secrets that need migration?

natalie: Run: `gh secret list --repo owner/repo` or use the scanner: `rg "secrets\.\w+" .github/workflows -S`. Also check `README` and infra scripts for hard-coded tokens.

omar: Will action permissions change?

natalie: Yes: workflows must request secrets at runtime via the vault action; we will add a short-lived VM role that allows read of `secret/ci/<repo>` for the job principal only. No repo-level write perms will be granted post-cutover.

vault-bot: Live migration started at 03:00:07 UTC. Applying access policies and writing secrets to `secret/ci/*`.

vault-bot: Live migration completed at 03:05:42 UTC. 142 repos migrated, 18 flagged for manual review.

infra-oncall: Observed brief 401s from a legacy deploy script that used a hard-coded token; owner notified and token rotated. No service outages.

security: Post-migration scanning shows no leaked repo secrets. We'll blacklist legacy secrets in 24h.

natalie: Thanks all. If you hit missing secret errors post-cutover, post repo + failed run link here and we'll triage. Closing ticket PLAT-10111 once manual reviews done.
